_description: User-correction phrases that the UserPromptSubmit detector flags. Mirror the regex set inlined in hooks/user-correction-detector.py. The hook loads this file at module import; tests override the path via CCGM_CORRECTION_PATTERNS. Order matters only for disambiguation when two patterns could match the same string; the first match wins. Patterns are case-insensitive and word-bounded where it makes sense. False positives are acceptable -- the analyzer's threshold logic is the second line of defense.

patterns.name: no_not_like_that
patterns.description: User says 'no, not like that' -- direct rejection of the agent's last action.

patterns.name: stop_doing
patterns.description: User says 'stop doing X' -- imperative halt on the current pattern of behavior.

patterns.name: dont_do_that
patterns.description: User says 'don't do that' / 'do not do this' -- explicit prohibition.

patterns.name: i_told_you
patterns.description: User says 'I told you ...' -- references a prior instruction the agent failed to follow.

patterns.name: wait_no
patterns.description: User says 'wait, no' -- interrupts the agent mid-action with a reversal.

patterns.name: actually_correction
patterns.description: User says 'actually, no' / 'actually, that's wrong' / 'actually, do ...' -- soft correction.

patterns.name: instead
patterns.description: User says '... instead' -- proposes an alternative to the agent's chosen approach.

patterns.name: thats_wrong
patterns.description: User says 'that's wrong' / 'that's not right' / 'that's incorrect' -- direct judgement.

patterns.name: undo
patterns.description: User says 'undo that' / 'revert this' / 'revert what you did' -- requests rollback.
